name: Srsly2
purpose: Psychoacoustic stereo widener in the style of the Hughes SRS: narrow boosts and cuts on the mid and side signals create a wide, holographic image. Can go from subtle spatial depth to extreme width.

params.name: Center
params.ai_hint: Mid-channel focus. 0.5 is a neutral start; raise for more presence in the centre, lower to open it up.

params.name: Space
params.ai_hint: Side-channel width. 0.5 is a moderate widening, 0.7-0.9 is very wide, 1.0 is extreme.

params.name: Level
params.ai_hint: Output level. 1.0 is unity; lower it if widening makes the sound louder.

params.name: Q
params.ai_hint: Intensity of the filters: 0 is half, 0.5 normal, 1.0 double. Higher is stronger and more obvious.

params.name: Dry/Wet
params.ai_hint: Dry/wet. 1.0 is fully processed; 0.4-0.7 keeps the original image and adds width.

notes: Upstream description: Srsly2 is a revisit of Srsly, to make the stereo widening more extreme.
All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Srsly2 is a more extreme revisit of Srsly; Airwindopedia suggests it can make a very wide reverb field.
Wide effects can collapse badly when summed to mono: check mono compatibility.
CPU: 0.86% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
